comment: The frozen sample of the differential's json area (distribution plan, milestone 11, M11-f): generated cases, each with the Node brain's answer, written by scripts/differential.mjs --freeze before the Node brain was deleted (its last version is tag v0.2.0-rc.3). Only cases where the Rust brain gave the same bytes were kept; the explained differences (test/DIVERGENCES.md) left out are counted in "skipped". crates/core/tests/frozen.rs requires the same answers. Don't edit by hand; a case the Rust brain should answer differently goes to the hand-written vectors instead.
